Best Bánh Mì in Vietnam.
Dec 2025 • Solo
A Perfect Bánh Mì Experience in Nha Trang!
I stopped by My Banh Mi in Nha Trang and was genuinely impressed. The bread was perfectly crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and the fillings were fresh, flavorful, and well-balanced. You can really taste the quality in every bite.
The staff were friendly, welcoming, and made the whole experience even better. The place is clean, cozy, and the service is quick ideal whether you’re grabbing a quick bite or enjoying a relaxed meal.
If you’re in Nha Trang and want an authentic, delicious bánh mì, this spot is a must-try. Highly recommended!
